name: Brewer's Trade
summary: In Hillsbrad, you carry Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok, where the brew-kin trade for Homebrew Hops. They miss the Fallrook family's vineyards, and cases of wine remain in the cellars.

sections.title: A Taste of the Past
sections.body: Fallrook wine still waits in the cellars, though most of the family's best bottled years are long gone. The brew-kin at Dun Garok miss those vineyards, so a trade has been arranged.

sections.title: The Exchange at Dun Garok
sections.body: You carry a case southeast to Dun Garok. The brew-kin gather beside the fireplace at the base of their fort. In return, you bring back a sack of their Homebrew Hops.

faq.q: What is being traded in this exchange?
faq.answer: A case of Fallrook Varietal wine goes from the cellars to the Dun Garok brew-kin, in return for a sack of their Homebrew Hops.

faq.q: Where in Dun Garok does the wine need to go?
faq.answer: You leave the wine with the brew-kin beside the fireplace where they gather, at the base of their fort.
Dun Garok lies in the southeast of Hillsbrad Foothills.
The Fallrooks were a family whose vineyards are missed. Most of their best bottled years have long since been drunk, though cases of their wine remain in the cellars.
